claim_ceiling: Synthetic injected errors on synthetic patients. Detection rates describe these declared error types only.
combinations: all 8 subsets of {M1,M2,M3}; the empty set detects nothing

endpoints.primary: error-instance recall: an instance is detected when any of its fields is flagged
secondary: false-positive rate on fields not touched by injection
form-level sensitivity and specificity (form has >=1 error)
field-level AUROC of the count of mechanisms flagging (full set)

error_types.E1_swap: values of two filled single-line text fields exchanged
error_types.E2_wrong_patient: a filled value replaced by the same field's value from another patient
error_types.E3_unit: a number written in the wrong unit (kg<->lb, cm->in)
error_types.E4_fabricated_none: a field whose correct answer is 'ask the patient' filled with 'None'
error_types.E5_post_seal_tamper: a value changed after the form was sealed (one digit, or another patient's value)
error_types.E6_dropped: a required filled field left blank
error_types.E7_typo: one character replaced by an OCR-confusable character
error_types.E8_stale: a vital sign replaced by an older observation of the same code

mechanisms.M1_merkle_breakpoint: Recompute every field leaf sha256(form_id|field_key|value) and the form Merkle root; a field is flagged when its leaf differs from the sealed leaf (the breakpoint). Sees only the form and its seal.
mechanisms.M2_lean4_constraints: Lean 4 (v4.15.0) program lean/FormChecks.lean evaluates declared per-field constraints (identity text fields required and well formed; ISO date not after 2026-11-01; phone NNN-NNN-NNNN; 5-digit ZIP; 2-letter state; select value in options; height_cm 30-250, weight_kg 0.5-350, weight_lb 1-800; blood pressure S/D integers with 40<=D<S<=300). Counts only if lean compiles the file, including its proof examples.
mechanisms.M3_fco_source_binding: Recompute each field from the teammate passport served by the local server, using the full candidate mapping (B0+L1+L2+L3); flag when the form value disagrees (lists as sets, numbers within 0.05, blanks compared).

statistics.attribution: a gain is attributed to mechanism m only on single-leaf edges; multi-leaf differences are reported as CONFOUNDED
statistics.fp_cost: the same paired test is applied to clean fields to report the false-positive cost of each edge
statistics.single_leaf_edges: S -> S+{m} for every S not containing m; LOMO = {M1,M2,M3}-{m} -> full
statistics.test: exact two-sided McNemar on paired error instances; paired bootstrap 10000 reps, seed 20261102, stratified by error type

written_before: any detector code exists in the repo; detectors are committed in a later commit
